final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.throws AS t, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS c FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), s AS (SELECT t, c, c*1.0/(SELECT SUM(c) FROM g) AS sh FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(sh) AS av FROM s) SELECT SUM(c) AS total_count, AVG(sh) AS avg_share, AVG(sh - (SELECT av FROM a)) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE sh > (SELECT av FROM a)
